PLEASE DISREGARD NOTICE OF NEUTRAL EVALUATION PROGRAM FOR |
COMMERCIAL DIVISION MATTERS SUPREME COURT NEW YORK COUNTY
CIVIL BRANCH

On December 9, a Notice Regarding the Neutral Evaluation Program for Commercial
Division Matters was inadvertently sent to a list of disposed matters due to an error.
The notice was intended for active, pending matters only. No further action is required
regarding disposed cases.

If you have any questions or concerns, please email Jean Norton, ADR Coordinator for
Supreme Court, New York County Civil Branch, at:jnorton@nycourts.gov
